evidence.title: Westcon-Comstor delivers FY26 growth as shift to software and services accelerates
evidence.summary: FY26 gross sales $5.74bn (+9.6%); gross profit $499.2m; cybersecurity $3.02bn and 52% of gross sales; recurring 68%; non-hardware 71%.

evidence.title: Datatec FY26 public investor overview
evidence.summary: Datatec describes Technology Distribution through Westcon International and publishes FY26 group results and reports.

evidence.title: Westcon-Comstor secures investment from General Atlantic
evidence.summary: General Atlantic becomes minority equity investor and long-term financing partner; Datatec remains majority owner.

evidence.title: Westcon-Comstor becomes Cloudflare EMEA-wide distributor
evidence.summary: EMEA distribution agreement with investment in professional services and a dedicated Cloudflare team; Southern Europe named as a priority market.

evidence.title: Westcon-Comstor expands support services for CrowdStrike and Zscaler partners
evidence.summary: Westcon announced expanded support services, including authorised CrowdStrike L1/L2 support in Spanish and expanded Zscaler services.

evidence.title: Palo Alto Networks solutions from Westcon-Comstor Spain
evidence.summary: Public Spanish vendor page confirms Palo Alto Networks relationship and Westcon value-added distribution capabilities.

evidence.title: Zscaler solutions from Westcon-Comstor Spain
evidence.summary: Public Spanish vendor page confirms Zscaler relationship and highlights combination with other Westcon security vendors.

evidence.title: F5 solutions from Westcon-Comstor Spain
evidence.summary: Public Spanish vendor page describes Westcon as F5 preferred distributor and its only worldwide distribution partner.

evidence.title: Check Point solutions from Westcon-Comstor Portugal
evidence.summary: Public Portuguese vendor page confirms Check Point relationship and Westcon pre-sales/support capabilities in Portugal.

evidence.title: Westcon-Comstor Spain public vendor sitemap
evidence.summary: Public sitemap confirms a broad set of Spanish vendor pages including AWS, Anomali, AttackIQ, Ciena, CrowdStrike, EfficientIP, Extreme, F5, Juniper, Microsoft, Nokia, Okta, Palo Alto Networks, Proofpoint, Ruckus, UiPath, Vectra and Zscaler.

evidence.title: Worldwide IT spending forecast 2026
evidence.summary: Gartner forecasts $6.37T worldwide IT spending in 2026 (+14.2%); data center systems +62.5% and IaaS +29.3% are major growth drivers.

evidence.title: Worldwide AI spending to grow 47% in 2026
evidence.summary: Gartner forecasts $2.59T AI spending in 2026 (+47%); AI infrastructure is the largest segment and AI cybersecurity is forecast at $51.3B.

evidence.title: Gartner top cybersecurity trends for 2026
evidence.summary: Public Gartner trend summary highlights agentic AI oversight, geopolitical pressures, regulatory volatility and new approaches to cyber risk and resilience.

evidence.title: EMEA IT Market 2026 Q2 updates
evidence.summary: IDC expects EMEA AI spending to reach $319B in 2026 (+19.2% YoY), with software, infrastructure and services benefiting while buying becomes more selective.

evidence.title: European CISO priorities in 2026: AI agents, platformization and sovereignty
evidence.summary: IDC identifies AI agents, security platform consolidation and digital sovereignty as forces reshaping European security buying; 16.7% of planned AI investment globally is cited for agent security/governance.

evidence.title: Europe 2026 tech spend exceeds €1.5T
evidence.summary: Forrester forecasts European tech spending above €1.5T in 2026 (+6.3%), driven by AI-optimized hardware, cloud, cybersecurity and sovereignty.

evidence.title: Forrester 2026 infrastructure and operations predictions
evidence.summary: Forrester predicts private AI factory adoption, security vendors expanding into secure LAN, and an agentic AI workflow autonomously preventing a major outage.

evidence.title: Forrester 2026 cybersecurity and risk predictions
evidence.summary: Forrester highlights agentic AI security risk and predicts quantum security spending will exceed 5% of overall IT security budgets in 2026.

evidence.title: Forrester 2026 European predictions
evidence.summary: Forrester expects stronger European sovereignty focus while large-scale displacement of US hyperscalers remains unlikely in the near term.

evidence.title: TD SYNNEX European distribution agreement with Palo Alto Networks
evidence.summary: TD SYNNEX announced a European distribution agreement for Palo Alto Networks focused on commercial and SMB VAR reach.

evidence.title: Arrow expands Palo Alto Networks distribution to Spain and Portugal
evidence.summary: Public channel coverage reports Arrow distribution of the full Palo Alto Networks portfolio in Spain and Portugal.

evidence.title: Exclusive Networks Palo Alto Networks ecosystem page
evidence.summary: Exclusive Networks public vendor page lists Spain and Portugal among country contexts for its Palo Alto Networks relationship.

evidence.title: CrowdStrike and Ignition Technology expand partnership across Europe
evidence.summary: CrowdStrike announced expanded distribution with Ignition Technology covering Spain and Portugal among six European markets.

evidence.title: CrowdStrike Authorized Support Partner Program in Europe
evidence.summary: CrowdStrike says its European distributor-led support program was developed with Ignition Technology and Westcon-Comstor.

evidence.title: Forecast Analysis: Information Security, Worldwide, 2026
evidence.summary: Gartner expects information-security spending to reach $244B in 2026, growing 11.6% in constant currency; AI-driven benefits and securing AI usage are explicit demand factors.

evidence.title: Worldwide AI Platforms and Models Market to Grow 63% in 2026
evidence.summary: Gartner projects $64B of end-user spending on AI models and platforms in 2026, +63.4%, with buyers increasingly scrutinizing cost, latency, performance and reliability.

evidence.title: Neocloud providers to capture 20% of the $267B AI cloud market by 2030
evidence.summary: Gartner forecasts a $267B AI cloud market by 2030 and expects neoclouds to capture 20%, with sovereign AI infrastructure emerging as a differentiator.

evidence.title: Critical Capabilities for SASE Platforms
evidence.summary: Public abstract highlights differences in securing AI, sovereign controls, postquantum cryptography, unified platform, administration and infrastructure delivery.

evidence.title: Critical Capabilities for Enterprise Wired and Wireless LAN
evidence.summary: Public abstract says vendors differ in operational software, advanced automation and zero-trust enforcement; use cases include AI/agentic automation and hands-off NetOps.

evidence.title: Critical Capabilities for Network Detection and Response
evidence.summary: Public abstract links NDR innovation to AI-driven SOC automation and hybrid/multicloud coverage; Vectra AI is included among evaluated vendors.

evidence.title: Critical Capabilities for CPS Protection Platforms
evidence.summary: Public criteria cover asset discovery, topology/data-flow mapping, security monitoring, segmentation, vulnerability and threat management, and enterprise integrations.

evidence.title: Market Overview for Workspace Cybersecurity Platforms
evidence.summary: Gartner sees endpoint protection converging with identity, application and data controls into modular, preintegrated workspace cybersecurity platforms.

evidence.title: The SASE Geopatriation Pivot: Addressing the Sovereign-First Era
evidence.summary: Public abstract says SASE sovereignty is moving beyond data residency toward jurisdiction-bound control planes, localized AI inference guardrails and regional partnerships.

evidence.title: HPE closes acquisition of Juniper Networks
evidence.summary: HPE completed the Juniper Networks acquisition, doubling HPE's networking business and combining campus, data center, routing, security and AI-native networking capabilities.
